title: Mémoire en chiffre du XIIe décembre 1560

transcription.notes: Editorial sign units measured by docs/_check_profile.py --measure cipher_tokens.txt --drop-first. The inherited ASCII convention conflates some graphic variants; 55 is not a definitive inventory of distinct cipher signs. Ten body pages, marginal addition and one-word dorse included.

system.summary: Cursive letter substitution with whole-word signs, provisionally homophonic; some apparent variants are transcription inconsistencies.
system.notes: The alphabet is only partially reconstructed. Do not use the inherited decoder as if it produced the normalized editorial reading.

prior_solution.where: Previous local project attempt was used. No external decipherment located; absence of all published prior art is not proven.

conditions.human_role: Supplied shelfmark, source URL and candidate description.

solution.what: Found previous project attempt with manuscript images, ten-page transcription, partial key and reading for final five pages; preserved a copy in main workspace. Earlier solver steps are described in inherited NOTES.md, not independently witnessed this session.
Inspected all ten page images and inherited sign transcription; reconstructed the first five pages and revised the final five. Normalization uses language context as well as partial substitution.
Inspected Lasry Charles IX–du Croc table preserved in ducroc/GL_CharlesIX.png; incompatible letter and code values. Henri II table retrieval failed with HTTP 503, so no Henri II test is claimed.
Read omitted marginal addition at 153r.14 and the cipher endorsement Advertissemens on presumed dorse 157v.
Regional enlargements resolved most inherited blanks, including pour les faire respondre par leur bouche, Si ainsi estoit, sement, oster; recognized a horizontal filler falsely transcribed as POUR.

Exact title, shelfmark and name searches found catalogue descriptions and general context but no matching reading or secure identification of Montseuignac. This is a limited negative search, not proof of novelty.
Retried seven residual passages against enlarged scans and repeated forms. Preserved doubts rather than choosing exact name or pronoun expansions. No independent clear copy or primary codebook found.
Counted 8262 transcribed sign units; excluded all 191 units on seven doubtful lines, yielding 8071/8262 = 97.688% conservative editorial coverage. Not independently measured decipherment accuracy.

outcome.fraction_read_source: coverage.tsv and cipher_tokens.txt: 8262 editorial sign units, 191 units on all seven bracketed lines conservatively excluded. Measures coverage of reconstructed coherent prose, not independent symbol accuracy.

gaps.detail: Plausible literal spelling, no external confirmation or exact graphic key; enlarged and searched.
Pronoun/relative meanings inferred, exact expansions and graphic distinctions remain uncertain after repeated-form comparison.
Sense suggests negative; exact initial glyph value not established at this occurrence.
Could be part of canceled group or an additional sign; retained unread.

outcome.notes: Read as a normalized editorial reconstruction with limited bracketed uncertainties. Partial inherited alphabet, no independent decipherment or held-out control. Continuing prior local work, not a fresh blind solve; first-publication priority not established.
